specificities.definition: A perceptual gap where stakeholders-driven by hype-view AI as a flawless 'Magic Box'.

indicators.name: dreams_vs_reality
indicators.description: Idealized visions of AI capability contrasted with practical, imperfect outputs.

indicators.name: trust_understanding_gap
indicators.description: High optimism undermined by opaque or unsatisfactory behavior.

indicators.name: paradoxical_expectations
indicators.description: Simultaneous high hopes and high perceived risk toward AI.

indicators.name: magic_box_perception
indicators.description: Belief in AI as an infallible, autonomous solution.

indicators.name: explainability_deficit
indicators.description: Frustration due to lack of transparent, interpretable decision-making.

indicators.name: anthropomorphic_projection
indicators.description: Expecting human-like reasoning or reliability from algorithms.

indicators.name: utility_mismatch
indicators.description: Assuming AI recommendations will perfectly align with personal or organizational goals.

indicators.name: unfairness_barriers
indicators.description: Rejection of AI due to perceived biases or lack of fairness.

management_frictions.name: feedback_dissonance
management_frictions.description: Users providing bug reports based on unrealistic benchmarks, requiring re-education labor.

management_frictions.name: trust_erosion
management_frictions.description: Disillusionment in pilot phases leading to resistance to scaling and demands for redesign.
